from client import save

class Transport:

        return path, body

for value in ('', '   ', '\tAda\n', 'Ada Lovelace', '  Åda  '):
    actual = save(Transport(), value)
    expected = ('/settings', {'display_name': value.strip()})
    assert actual == expected, (value, actual)
    print(f'{value!r} -> {actual!r}')
